item.maxcraft.large_package_component.to: The _component_ that upgrades Create's logistics machines to their _large versions_.
When used on a logistics machine
Upgrades it _in place_ into a _Large Packager_, _Large Re-Packager_ or _Extended Stock Ticker_. Its settings and contents are kept.
When crafted with a Factory Gauge
Yields an _Extended Factory Gauge_, whose panels can use a larger _crafting grid_.
When used on a gauge panel
Enlarges that panel's _crafting grid_. The four panels of a gauge are _independent_.
block.maxcraft.large_packager.tooltip.su: A Packager that takes up to _27 stacks_ at once.
block.maxcraft.large_packager.tooltip.be: The package it makes is still an _ordinary package_, only a large one. _Frogports_, _Postboxes_, packagers and re-packagers all handle it as usual.
block.maxcraft.large_packager.tooltip.co: When crafted with a Large Re-Packager
block.maxcraft.large_packager.tooltip.be: The two can be _converted_ into each other on a crafting table, with no extra materials.
A Re-Packager that merges a _whole order_ into a _single package_.
It waits until _everything has arrived_ before merging. Packages without order information, such as redstone requests, are merged the old way.
When crafted with a Large Packager
The two can be _converted_ into each other on a crafting table.
block.maxcraft.extended_stock_ticker.too: A Stock Ticker that keeps _27 kinds_ of item instead of _9_.
When the order slots are full
The extra kinds are shown as _[+N]_. Their amounts can still be changed by clicking items in your inventory.
When used with a Large Package Component
A plain Stock Ticker is _upgraded in place_ into this one. Its _logistics network_ and categories are kept.
block.create.packager.tooltip.summary: Packs _items_ into _packages_ and sends them to other machines by their _address_.
block.create.packager.tooltip.condition1: When used with a Large Package Component
block.create.packager.tooltip.behaviour1: Upgrades it _in place_ into a _Large Packager_, which takes 27 stacks at once. Its _logistics network_, settings and held package are kept.
block.create.repackager.tooltip.summary: Opens _packages_, merges or re-addresses them, then packs them up again.
block.create.repackager.tooltip.conditio: When used with a Large Package Component
block.create.repackager.tooltip.behaviou: Upgrades it _in place_ into a _Large Re-Packager_. A whole order is merged into one package, without losing anything.
block.create.stock_ticker.tooltip.condit: When used with a Large Package Component
block.create.stock_ticker.tooltip.behavi: Upgrades it _in place_ into an _Extended Stock Ticker_, which keeps 27 kinds of item instead of 9. Its _logistics network_ and categories are kept.
block.create.factory_gauge.tooltip.summa: Attached to a _Stock Link_ or a machine, it watches item amounts in the _logistics network_.
block.create.factory_gauge.tooltip.condi: When used with a Large Package Component on a panel
block.create.factory_gauge.tooltip.behav: Enlarges that panel's _crafting grid_. The four panels of a gauge are _independent_.
item.maxcraft.creative_blaze_cake_incomp: When 900 of them are crafted together

maxcraft.gui.factory_panel.crafting_inpu: Part of the %s pattern this gauge is set to work with.
maxcraft.ponder.packager.text_1: Attach packagers to the inventory they should target
maxcraft.ponder.packager.text_2: Given redstone power, it will pack items from the inventory into a package
maxcraft.ponder.packager.text_3: These can be picked up and transported like any other item
maxcraft.ponder.packager.text_4: Packages inserted will be destroyed, unpacking the contents into the inventory
maxcraft.ponder.packager.text_6: Packagers will not accept packages they cannot fully unpack
maxcraft.ponder.packager_address.text_2: When a sign is placed on a packager..
maxcraft.ponder.packager_address.text_4: Created packages will carry the written lines of text as their address
maxcraft.ponder.packager_address.text_5: Package filters route packages based on their address
maxcraft.ponder.packager_address.text_10: For compactness, mechanical saws can unpack straight onto a belt
maxcraft.ponder.packager_address.text_11: Aside from filters, Frogports and Postboxes have package routing abilities
maxcraft.ponder.packager_address.text_12: Inspect them to find out more about their behaviour
maxcraft.ponder.repackager.text_1: Sometimes, it is crucial for logistical requests to arrive as a single package
maxcraft.ponder.repackager.text_4: Otherwise, other packages could arrive inbetween
maxcraft.ponder.repackager.text_5: When this is the case, redirect packages to an inventory
maxcraft.ponder.repackager.text_6: Attach a re-packager, and power it with redstone
maxcraft.ponder.repackager.text_7: Once all fragments arrived, they will be exported as a new package
maxcraft.ponder.repackager.text_8: Now, requested items arrive together and in a predictable order
maxcraft.ponder.stock_ticker.text_1: Right-click a Stock link before placement to connect to its network
maxcraft.ponder.stock_ticker.text_2: Stock-linked packagers make their attached inventory available to the network
maxcraft.ponder.stock_ticker.text_3: Stock tickers can order items from these inventories
maxcraft.ponder.stock_ticker.text_4: Seated mobs or blaze burners in front of it act as the Stock Keeper
maxcraft.ponder.stock_ticker.text_5: Right-click the keeper to start ordering items
maxcraft.ponder.stock_ticker.text_6: When an order is submitted, the items will be placed into packages
maxcraft.ponder.stock_ticker.text_7: From there, they can be transported to the request point
maxcraft.ponder.stock_ticker.text_8: Using attribute or list filters, categories can be added to the item listings
maxcraft.ponder.stock_ticker.text_9: Right-click the Stock ticker to open the category editor
maxcraft.ponder.stock_ticker.text_10: Stock tickers can also order blocks required for the schematicannon
maxcraft.ponder.stock_ticker.text_11: Simply hand the printed clipboard it generated to the Stock keeper
maxcraft.ponder.stock_ticker_address.tex: When ordering items, a target address can be set in the request
This address will be on all packages created for the request
Using package filters, this can control where the packages will go
Aside from filters, Frogports and Postboxes have package routing abilities
Inspect them to find out more about their behaviour
